params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'
$wt='C:\Users\Xxkan\AppData\Local\Temp\mhw-workflows-feature-dryrun'
$branch='audit/workflows-feature-dryrun-20260929'
git -C $repo fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
if(Test-Path $wt){ git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt | Out-Null }
git -C $repo show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$branch"
if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){ git -C $repo branch -D $branch | Out-Null }
git -C $repo worktree add -b $branch $wt origin/main | Out-Null
Set-Location $wt
$base=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
git cherry-pick -n 02fa1dd5c3e98d319067043598bfdfd32617e65f
$exit=$LASTEXITCODE
$conf=@(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)
$added=@(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A)
$modified=@(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=M)
[pscustomobject]@{base=$base;cherry_pick_exit=$exit;conflicts=$conf;added=$added;modified=$modified} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
git cherry-pick --abort 2>$null
git reset --hard HEAD | Out-Null
Set-Location $repo
git worktree remove --force $wt | Out-Null
git branch -D $branch | Out-Null
exit 0
